_comment: Bubblewrap manifest template for the STOP Trusted Web Activity. Copy this file into the local clone of your TWA project (NOT this repo — Bubblewrap expects it at the root of its own working directory) and run `bubblewrap update && bubblewrap build`. The fields marked TODO must be replaced with real values from your Play Console / signing keystore before building. The `playBilling` feature flag below is what unlocks the Digital Goods API on the JavaScript side; without it window.getDigitalGoodsService is undefined and the app falls back to Stripe.
name: STOP - El Juego
